kind: "package-reference""},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Summary"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The right Sidebar: where the docking kit meets this product. It holds one docking surface per sessio"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"n, draws it as one edge-anchored panel in the frame's right column in either of two presentations, p"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"uts the expand button in the conversation header, and owns the navigation controller (`ctx.sidebarRi"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ght`), the tab-type registry (`ctx.sidebarRightTabs`), and the Tab domain that tells each open tab h"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ow it was navigated to and how long it lives."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What lives here, and what does not"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The layout itself — the split tree, its operations, the drag gestures, the floating panels — belongs"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" to `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-dockkit` and stays host-agnostic. This package supplies everything t"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"hat kit refuses to know: the product's copy, what a tab's `kind` means, which tab a fresh pane is se"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"eded with, where the surface is mounted, and how other plugins reach it."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Presentations"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Normal and fullscreen presentations share the same content tree, so switching does not remount tabs."},{"id":"p10s2","text":" The normal panel anchors to the right column; fullscreen covers the viewport while retaining the wi"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"de-screen columns underneath. Opening below 768px uses fullscreen automatically; leaving fullscreen "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"on a narrow viewport closes the panel, and widening does not reopen a closed panel. A fullscreen ope"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ning keeps the underlying columns unchanged until its slide finishes, then prepares the normal track"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" without a column transition. Before a fullscreen panel retreats, closing prepares a full-width conv"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ersation and restoring prepares the normal right track; the background does not animate during the r"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"n and restoring prepares the normal right track; the background does not animate during the retreat."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Mode | The track | The panel |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| `push` (default) | Panel width: the conversation makes room | In the track; its left edge and the "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"conversation's right edge travel together, on the frame's own curve |
| `fullscreen` | Retains the w"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ide-screen normal track; automatic narrow-screen fullscreen takes no track | Covers the entire viewp"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"creen normal track; automatic narrow-screen fullscreen takes no track | Covers the entire viewport |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"In Windows Electron, `html[data-windows-titlebar]` keeps fullscreen panels below the caption and to "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"the right of the expanded sidebar. The frame's `--dsh-windows-sidebar-width` supplies that inset and"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" maximum width; `--dsh-windows-content-radius` supplies the top-left radius. Only fullscreen panels "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"clip overflow for that corner."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The seat reports presentation through `ctx.layout.openRightbar(track, fullscreen)` / `closeRightbar("},{"id":"p14s2","text":")`; the frame does not inject this package. Switching fullscreen on a wide viewport leaves the cente"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"r width unchanged, and the width handle appears only in expanded normal mode. Independent floating p"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"anels and `float`/`dock` operations remain available."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## The expand button"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The shortcut reference includes right-sidebar toggle, split and panel fullscreen commands. The same "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"effective binding appears on the corresponding controls. Split and fullscreen require focus within a"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" visible dock pane; conversation focus leaves them unavailable. Split remains visible when unavailab"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"le; its focusable tooltip shows the current binding and explains the pane limit or width requirement"},{"id":"p17s5","text":". Files, browser, and terminal providers contribute their own commands. Guide buttons display effect"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"ive shortcuts as unboxed text inline without duplicate tooltips."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"While the panel is hidden, one button in the conversation header's corner seat (`conversation.sessio"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"n.header.corner`, past the utilities' right edge and level with the Session log control) is the way "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"back in. Its glyph is the left sidebar's collapse icon mirrored. It uses the shared compact Button, "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"matching the adjacent More action’s radius and hover fill. It shares the panel's store (the slot run"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"time allows one handle across two same-scope seats); while the panel is shown it renders nothing, an"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"d the corner seat collapses with it. A collapsed Sidebar therefore costs the conversation nothing: n"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"o rail, no width, and the transcript's scrollbar stays at the column's edge. Without a session there"},{"id":"p18s8","text":" is no button and no panel."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The panel takes the conversation's ground colour and content font sizes rather than a raised layer o"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"f its own: it is a column of the page, not a card over it."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The root-scoped `rightbar` entry renders the selected Session and background Sessions with initializ"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ed `keepMounted` bodies through separate `rightbar.session` subtrees. Each View owns its Session ref"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"erence. Only the foreground subtree reports a frame track; other subtrees stay hidden without deleti"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"the foreground subtree reports a frame track; other subtrees stay hidden without deleting tab state."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## State"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Extension seats"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **Browser-local layout.** Layout does not synchronize between devices; provider-specific state req"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"uires its provider's recovery support.
- **No surface without a session.** State is keyed by session"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" id, so the hero screen shows nothing on the right.
- **Hard-coded stacking.** The content tree uses"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" a fixed stacking layer; floats reorder within it without raising that layer above menus.
- **Retain"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"ed Session deletion.** Catalog absence alone does not retire an initialized retained View; its tab l"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"ifetimes and plugin teardown own release.
- **Undo is not exposed.** The recorded sequence is steppe"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"d only through the `@internal` service methods; product controls are deliberately absent.
- **Titles"},{"id":"p26s8","text":" are fixed at open time.** A type's `title(address)` is captured into the record; a live title comes"},{"id":"p26s9","text":" only from the optional title seat.
- **No content navigation stack.** Stepping back replays layout "},{"id":"p26s10","text":"operations; an editor-style back/forward over visited content is not built."}],"truncated":true}
